items.question: Which mantra formula must be uttered while touching all fingers with the thumb?
premises: The mantra formula is oṃ samānāya svāhā.
The word iti marks this formula as spoken.
All fingers are to be touched with the thumb.
items.inference: One should utter the mantra oṃ samānāya svāhā and touch all fingers with the thumb.
uncertainties: The specific ritual context of this gesture depends on the preceding instructions.
items.plain_english: Uttering 'oṃ samānāya svāhā', one should touch all the fingers with the thumb.
